title: Our Planet Earth
source: Science G3 B1 Study sheet pp.38-40, Worksheet Q2

scenes.t: Is the Earth flat like a coin, or round like a ball? Let's think like scientists!
If the Earth were flat, maybe the oceans would pour off the edges into space, and travelers could fall off the end!
That never happens, because the Earth is spherical, like a ball. A sphere has no edges or ends.
Long ago, in 1267, the Persian astronomer Jamal ad-Din Bukhari brought a globe, a round model of the Earth, to China.
Inside, the Earth has layers, just like an egg. An egg has a shell, a white and a yolk.
The crust is the thin outer layer we live on. It is made of rock.
The mantle is under the crust. It is thicker than the crust and very hot, like lava.
The core is the center of the Earth. It is even hotter than the mantle!

items.a: Shaped like a ball. The Earth is spherical.
A round model of the Earth.
The thin outer layer we live on, made of rock.
Thicker than the crust and very hot, like lava.
The center of the Earth, the hottest part.
In the egg model, the shell is like the crust.
The egg white is like the mantle.
The yolk is like the core.

activities.title: Memory: Egg & Earth
activities.prompt: Match the egg part with the Earth layer.

activities.title: Which Layer?
activities.prompt: Which layer of the Earth is this?

why.m: The thick, hot layer like lava.

activities.title: The Egg Earth Model
activities.goal: See the Earth's three layers using a boiled egg.
activities.safe: An adult must cut the egg.

predict.q: Which part of the egg will be in the very center?

steps.t: Look at the boiled egg. The thin shell is like the Earth's crust.
Ask an adult to cut the egg in half, with the shell still on.
Find the three layers: shell, white and yellow yolk.
Point and say: shell is the crust, white is the mantle, yolk is the core!

activities.result: You can see a thin shell, a thick white layer and a yolk in the middle — just like the crust, mantle and core.
activities.why: The crust is thin like the shell, the mantle is thick like the white, and the core is in the center like the yolk.
